description: Source-backed contract for FOnline Ogg/Theora video delivery, decoding, fullscreen playback, script-owned playback, rendering, and validation boundaries.

scope.support_note: The current CPU-decoded Ogg/Theora path is revision-pinned while focused native fixtures, production cinematic evidence, and a versioned compatibility policy are missing.
included: OGV raw-copy delivery and exact-path resource loading
Ogg packetization and Theora header/frame decoding
CPU YCbCr-to-RGBA conversion and texture upload
fullscreen playback, queues, input interruption, and separate music pairing
current diagnostics, limitations, and embedding-project validation
excluded: project cinematic catalogs, story triggers, subtitle systems, localization, skip policy, and save-state consequences
container audio decoding, voice tracks, audio mixing, and synchronization beyond a separately started music resource
hardware/platform media decoders, streaming from disk or network, adaptive bitrate, and DRM
MP4, WebM, AVI, MPEG, animated images, and non-Theora Ogg video
mastering, accessibility, licensing, attribution, and source provenance

formats.name: Ogg video resource
formats.requirement: Deliver an Ogg resource containing a Theora video stream through a client-visible RawCopy pack and pass its exact resource path to the video API.
formats.rationale: OGV is the stock raw-copy convention; the decoder reads Ogg pages and feeds Theora headers and packets rather than dispatching a generic media framework.

formats.name: Theora elementary video in Ogg
formats.requirement: Use a decodable Theora stream with valid dimensions, frame-rate metadata, and one of the supported 4:2:0, 4:2:2, or 4:4:4 pixel formats.
formats.rationale: The bundled path links libtheora directly and has no alternate codec dispatch.

delivery_rules.name: Raw-copy delivery
delivery_rules.requirement: Keep ogv in Baking.RawCopyFileExtensions and include RawCopy in the client-only resource pack that owns video files.
delivery_rules.rationale: There is no video baker; playback consumes the delivered bytes.

delivery_rules.name: Exact resource path
delivery_rules.requirement: Pass the complete delivered video path, including its extension; video lookup has no default suffix or normalized stem index.
delivery_rules.rationale: Both fullscreen and script-owned paths call Resources.ReadFile with the supplied path.

delivery_rules.name: Client runtime ownership
delivery_rules.requirement: Deliver video to client resources and invoke playback on the client or mapper runtime.
delivery_rules.rationale: Decoding, texture creation, drawing, and exported methods live in the client layer.

delivery_rules.name: Whole-resource memory budget
delivery_rules.requirement: Budget compressed file bytes, one CPU RGBA frame, and one GPU texture for each active playback; the stock path is not streaming from the resource store.
delivery_rules.rationale: ReadFile.GetData moves the complete resource into VideoClip.RawVideoData before packet decoding.

decoding_rules.name: Ogg page and packet ingestion
decoding_rules.requirement: Treat the input as Ogg pages read into the sync layer in 1024-byte portions and support at most ten simultaneously discovered logical streams.
decoding_rules.rationale: DecodePacket owns a fixed ten-stream state table and copies bounded portions from the in-memory resource.

decoding_rules.name: Theora header selection
decoding_rules.requirement: Provide a stream whose headers are accepted by th_decode_headerin and whose setup can allocate a decoder context.
decoding_rules.rationale: Construction fails when packet seeking, setup data, or decoder allocation fails.

decoding_rules.name: Clock-derived frame selection
decoding_rules.requirement: Author valid fps numerator and denominator metadata; frame selection derives the target frame from elapsed monotonic time and decoder cost.
decoding_rules.rationale: RenderFrame multiplies elapsed seconds by the Theora fps ratio and decodes the positive frame difference.

decoding_rules.name: Supported chroma subsampling
decoding_rules.requirement: Use TH_PF_420, TH_PF_422, or TH_PF_444; any other Theora pixel format stops playback.
decoding_rules.rationale: The CPU conversion chooses chroma divisors only for those three enum values.

decoding_rules.name: CPU RGBA output
decoding_rules.requirement: Expect each decoded frame to be converted from YCbCr to opaque RGBA on the CPU before texture upload.
decoding_rules.rationale: RenderFrame writes clamped RGB components and alpha 0xFF into RenderedTextureData.

decoding_rules.name: Decode failure stops playback
decoding_rules.requirement: Treat malformed frame data, color output failure, unsupported pixel format, and end-of-stream as stop conditions and inspect client logs.
decoding_rules.rationale: Frame errors log and call Stop; end-of-stream also stops the clip.

anchors: Frame does not contain encoded video data

decoding_rules.name: No container-audio decode
decoding_rules.requirement: Do not rely on an audio stream embedded in the Ogg video; author audio as a separate client music resource when needed.
decoding_rules.rationale: VideoClip links Theora packet decoding only, while fullscreen pairing starts SoundManager music from the path after a vertical bar.

fullscreen_rules.name: Fullscreen playback entry point
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Use Game.PlayVideo(videoName, canInterrupt, enqueue) for the built-in fullscreen path.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: The exported client method delegates to ClientEngine.PlayVideo.

fullscreen_rules.name: Replacement clears current queue
fullscreen_rules.requirement: A non-enqueued request replaces the active clip and clears every queued request before attempting to load the new path.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: PlayVideo resets _video and clears _videoQueue before resource lookup.

fullscreen_rules.name: Queue while active
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Set enqueue only to append behind an already active fullscreen clip; with no active clip, the request starts immediately and clears any stale queue.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: The enqueue branch is conditional on _video, and ProcessVideo starts queued entries sequentially.

fullscreen_rules.name: Input interruption
fullscreen_rules.requirement: When canInterrupt is true, key-down, mouse-down, and touch input events stop the active clip; design project skip policy around this broad input set.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: ProcessInputEvent stops the clip before normal input handling for the enumerated event classes.

fullscreen_rules.name: Separate music pairing
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Use video-path|music-path to stop current music and start a separate one-shot music resource alongside the video; additional separators are not a playlist.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: PlayVideo splits the request, loads the first component, and uses only names[1] for SoundManager music.

fullscreen_rules.name: Completion stops music
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Expect fullscreen clip completion or interruption to stop the client's current music group, including music not started by the video.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: ProcessVideo unconditionally calls StopMusic when the active clip reports stopped.

fullscreen_rules.name: Late fullscreen draw
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Expect the built-in frame to draw after Game.OnRenderIface and stretch over the complete current render target without alpha blending.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: MainLoop calls ProcessVideo after OnRenderIface, and DrawTexture without source/target regions fills the target.

fullscreen_rules.name: Missing fullscreen resource
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Validate fullscreen resource existence before transitions; a missing file silently leaves no active clip after current playback and queue were cleared.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: The void PlayVideo path returns when ReadFile fails and exposes no failure result.

fullscreen_rules.name: Playing status includes queued work
fullscreen_rules.requirement: Interpret Game.IsVideoPlaying as active-or-queued state, not proof that a frame is currently visible.
fullscreen_rules.rationale: ClientEngine reports true for an active playback or a non-empty queue.

embedded_rules.name: Script-owned playback creation
embedded_rules.requirement: Use Game.CreateVideoPlayback(exactPath, looped) to create an independent ref-counted playback and texture.
embedded_rules.rationale: The exported PassOwnership method loads the resource, constructs VideoClip, creates a texture, and stores both in VideoPlayback.

embedded_rules.name: Creation failure throws
embedded_rules.requirement: Catch or prevent a missing script-owned video resource; creation throws Video file not found.
embedded_rules.rationale: Unlike fullscreen PlayVideo, CreateVideoPlayback converts a missing ReadFile result into ScriptException.

embedded_rules.name: RenderIface-only drawing
embedded_rules.requirement: Call Game.DrawVideoPlayback only from Game.OnRenderIface handling.
embedded_rules.rationale: The method throws outside the client script draw scope.

embedded_rules.name: Positive target size advances
embedded_rules.requirement: Pass a positive width and height every frame; zero or negative size skips frame decode, texture upload, and drawing.
embedded_rules.rationale: RenderFrame is called only inside the positive-size branch.

embedded_rules.name: Caller-owned rectangle and aspect
embedded_rules.requirement: Choose and maintain the target rectangle and aspect policy in project UI code; the Engine draws exactly the supplied position and size.
embedded_rules.rationale: DrawVideoPlayback constructs irect32 directly from the script arguments.

embedded_rules.name: Stopped field lifecycle
embedded_rules.requirement: Poll VideoPlayback.Stopped only after continuing to draw the instance; the flag becomes true when DrawVideoPlayback observes that the clip stopped.
embedded_rules.rationale: The draw method clears resources and sets the exported field after the stop check.

embedded_rules.name: Null and completed instances are no-ops
embedded_rules.requirement: Passing null or an instance whose playback resources were cleared performs no draw and does not throw.
embedded_rules.rationale: DrawVideoPlayback returns early for both states after enforcing render scope.

validation_rules.name: Delivered-byte validation
validation_rules.requirement: Bake and inspect the exact client resource path and bytes before runtime playback.
validation_rules.rationale: RawCopy is the only delivery transform and runtime paths are exact.

validation_rules.name: Visible-client requirement
validation_rules.requirement: Validate first frame, motion, end, skip, queue, resize, and texture cleanup in a visible client on every claimed platform.
validation_rules.rationale: No headless or source-only check proves texture upload and presentation.

validation_rules.name: Missing native video fixture
validation_rules.requirement: Treat the lack of Test_*Video* or Test_*Theora* as a coverage gap and keep visible regression evidence mandatory.
validation_rules.rationale: The current native test inventory contains no focused video decoder/playback source.

validation_rules.name: Looping requires explicit proof
validation_rules.requirement: Do not promise looping cinematics until a multi-cycle visible regression proves decoder rewind and frame continuity for the exact asset.
validation_rules.rationale: SetLooped is exposed through creation, but the current source has no focused loop fixture.

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project acceptance
validation_rules.requirement: An embedding project owns cinematic triggers, recipients, skip/queue policy, subtitles, localization, aspect fit, audio strategy, save consequences, assets, provenance, budgets, and acceptance tests.
validation_rules.rationale: The Engine supplies decoder and presentation primitives, not a game cinematic system.
